KISWAHILI — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   B. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   C. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   D. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.

2. When practising Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 1.1.1 Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mazungumzo, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 1.1.1 Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mazungumzo.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 1.1.1 Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mazungumzo.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 1.1.1 Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mazungumzo.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 1.1.1 Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mazungumzo.

3. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. mitoto
   B. watoto
   C. kitoto
   D. mato

4. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. zito
   B. fupi
   C. nene
   D. pana

5. When practising Kusikiliza kwa Kina Sauti /dh/ na /th/, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Kusikiliza kwa Kina Sauti /dh/ na /th/.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Kusikiliza kwa Kina Sauti /dh/ na /th/.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kusikiliza kwa Kina Sauti /dh/ na /th/.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Kusikiliza kwa Kina Sauti /dh/ na /th/.
